answer.says: Thanda mat hone do. Yes, I will drink the chai. The body's demand for warmth is a universal right that no holiday can suspend.
answer.thought: Sunil's command to stop philosophizing and simply eat is a practical negation of my speculative excess. He treats the samosa as a particular thing to be consumed, not a concept to be sublated. I will obey, for the body is the first ethical substance I must attend to before I can attend to the State.
